newsitem.title: USA: Snap-on Inc Q1 net rises on improved sales.
newsitem.headline: Snap-on Inc Q1 net rises on improved sales.

text.p: Snap-on Inc said Thrusday improved sales across all three of its geographic segments helped earnings climb in the first quarter ended March 29.
The company reported net income of $33.9 million, or $0.56 a share, up from $29.7 million, or $0.49, in the same period last year. Sales rose to $375.3 million from $344.4 million.
Snap-on said several focused acquisitions contributed significantly to the sales increase, and operating expenses as a percent of sales declined slighly.
Snap-on makes tools and equipment for technicians, service shop operators and industrial tool users.
Its shares were trading off 3/4 Thursday at 36-5/8.
